scope: Research-only software equivalence; no wall-clock benchmark, speedup, or physical-flight claim.

app_snapshot.source_map: The complete 428-path map is in the hashed flight-equivalence report; the harness verified the map unchanged before and after the run.
app_snapshot.console_note: Six aircraft data warning lines reported Jyy 0.3692 kg m2 is 2.02x the scaled UltraStick25e value. No Godot WARNING/ERROR diagnostics were emitted.

candidate.scope: Injected into detached test fixtures only; the accepted profile identity remains pinned to the production pilot.

source_identity.change_review: The candidate differs from pilot.gd by one four-line early return after the nominal baseline score. For an unheld controller with a nonnegative score, it returns the same unmodified traffic response that production returns after evaluating alternate bank scores.

fixture.scenario: Detached real player and two companion FlightSessions, full Club scenery collision world and field lights, near_runway lake context, default weather, and the same scripted player controls at each common tick.

compared_frames: player and companion state, previous state, inputs, aux, continuous, modes, loads, contact events, and scenery damage
player commands, raw controls, trims, requested controls, and agent command/session controls
controller snapshot state, held-maneuver latch, tick/wind/clearance, decision diagnostics, and manager accepted ticks/batches/damage flag

audit.score_purity: _score_bank uses its input and controller planning wind to compute local values and returns a result without writing controller state. Both paths return before diagnostic updates for unheld nonnegative scores, so decision and diagnostic state stays equal.
audit.coverage: No-traffic and filtered-empty traffic retain the super path. Held maneuvers and negative scores retain the original evaluation path. The candidate guard only matches the existing unheld, nonnegative-score early-return condition.
audit.subclass_limit: A subclass that overrides _score_bank with observable side effects would observe fewer calls. The equivalence claim covers the concrete production controller behavior plus the test-only score-count instrumentation.

limits: Software equivalence only; deterministic score-call savings are not a wall-clock speedup measurement.
